coordinateSystem: glTF: right-handed, +Y up, metres, models face +Z. Babylon's glTF loader converts to its left-handed scene with a __root__ node.

meshoptDecoder.configure: MeshoptCompression.Configuration = { decoder: { url: BASE_URL + 'vendor/babylon/meshopt_decoder.js' } } before the first load (otherwise Babylon fetches it from cdn.babylonjs.com)

babylon.textures: GLB textures are external files (tex/<name>) next to each GLB; load the GLB by its full URL so relative URIs resolve.

normalMaps.glbAssets: Nothing to do: Babylon's glTF loader sets invertNormalMapX/Y itself (glTFLoader setNormalMapInversions(!useRightHandedSystem, useRightHandedSystem)).
normalMaps.textureSets: assets/textures/*/normal.jpg are OpenGL (+Y up). On a Babylon mesh built in code in the default left-handed scene, sampled with a Texture loaded with the default invertY = true, set material.invertNormalMapX = true AND material.invertNormalMapY = true (both). With invertY = false textures, set invertNormalMapX = true only. Proven numerically in tests/assets/normalMapConvention.test.ts against Babylon's own cotangent_frame shader code.

babylon.vertexColors: Many nature/prop meshes carry COLOR_0; per glTF it multiplies baseColor, and Babylon's loader applies it. Ranges are in each mesh entry (vertexColor).
